authority: filesystem metadata and reviewed SKILL.md frontmatter
scope_semantics: project means repository backup location here, not a separate active runtime
runtime_policy: one active monolithic project; global Codex skills are the runtime surface; tracked copies are backup/review artifacts
privacy: identifiers and role metadata only; no prompts, secrets, transcripts, or raw logs

skills.trigger: non-trivial Theseus local-lab work, routing conflicts, tool-policy checks
skills.handoff_or_executor: selected project/global skill and route packet
skills.stop_or_verification_note: router is a thin dispatcher; selected route remains provisional until verification

skills.trigger: prior context, decisions, handoff, recall, memory or continuity work
skills.handoff_or_executor: AutoMem, MemPalace, or bounded local fallback
skills.stop_or_verification_note: memory is not current runtime authority; health/recall and write-read verification when applicable

skills.trigger: PowerShell, WSL, Bash, Node, Docker, Git, JSON/text, quoting-sensitive work
skills.handoff_or_executor: VS Code task, Node wrapper, WSL, MCP, or thin Windows bridge
skills.stop_or_verification_note: reroute after one quoting failure; repeated command becomes task/script candidate

skills.trigger: fresh research, external technical evidence, plugin choice, disputed claim
skills.handoff_or_executor: one primary oracle and at most one corroborator
skills.stop_or_verification_note: local evidence outranks plugins; no noisy oracle swarm

skills.trigger: Copilot, GitHub Actions, Wiki, Issues, Projects, or Copilot tooling advice
skills.stop_or_verification_note: second opinion only; local evidence and repository checks remain authoritative

skills.trigger: same route or failure class is about to be retried
skills.stop_or_verification_note: after materially equivalent repeated failures, declare loop and stop blind retry

skills.trigger: recalled, imported, federated memory may be treated as authority or capability claim
skills.handoff_or_executor: current runtime verification before action or promotion
skills.stop_or_verification_note: memory claim is not live approval or runtime fact

skills.trigger: Windows CLI, Docker, VS Code tasks, local services, repeated checks
skills.handoff_or_executor: native tool, existing task, MCP, or small wrapper
skills.stop_or_verification_note: prefer bounded read-only diagnostics and preserve context boundaries

skills.trigger: external/current research, source discovery, or verification
skills.handoff_or_executor: direct authoritative fetch or bounded search/fetch/corroboration route
skills.stop_or_verification_note: SEARCH, FETCH, CORROBORATOR, and AUTHORITY remain distinct

skills.trigger: Git status, commit, push, GitHub sync, advisor or secret-sensitive staging
skills.handoff_or_executor: Git safety scanner, VS Code task, or approved GitHub route
skills.stop_or_verification_note: inspect scope, scan staged files, and require explicit push authority

skills.trigger: prior context, decisions, handoff, recall, memory or continuity work
skills.handoff_or_executor: AutoMem, MemPalace, or bounded local fallback
skills.stop_or_verification_note: global default; project overlay must be resolved before duplicate selection

skills.trigger: shell, Docker, WSL, Node, Git, quoting, JSON/text, or Windows bridge work
skills.handoff_or_executor: VS Code task, Node wrapper, WSL, MCP, or thin Windows bridge
skills.stop_or_verification_note: global default; project overlay must be resolved before duplicate selection

skills.trigger: non-trivial Theseus work and skill priority conflicts
skills.stop_or_verification_note: global default; project router is current overlay and remains under review
